title: Prove one-turn SSE transport
description:
Purpose: replace the unmeasured streaming premise with evidence before building the cloud API.

Definition of Done:
- Feasibility test 1 runs against the direct Lambda function URL and CloudFront paths.
- Foreground, background-tab, reconnect, and mobile Safari observations are recorded.
- The measured front door is selected without weakening scale-to-zero or the one-turn stream boundary.
- The completed test is removed from FEASIBILITY_TESTS.md and its result is recorded in the document it gates.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Status 2026-08-30:

Done: Test 1 (chatticus-bbfb8d) merged; stack ChatticusSseSpike destroyed; mermaid follow-up (chatticus-f0f9e0) closed.

Still open on the original DoD: mobile Safari was not measured. Do not treat CloudFront as the product front door. Do not rebuild the spike. Leave this epic open until that gap is either measured or explicitly waived by the owner.
